```yaml
      no_trace_plateau_accuracy: 0.751
      no_trace_curve_shape: rapid_plateau_low_ceiling
      convergence_ratio_exception_vs_vota: 1.9
      convergence_ratio_exception_vs_fulltrace: 3.8
      learning_efficiency_exception_samples_per_pp: 9.2
      learning_efficiency_fulltrace_samples_per_pp: 68.5
      efficiency_ratio: 7.4
    result_rationale: >
      Training dynamics 直接测量 information density 对 learning efficiency 的 
      影响。所有数值表示为 training fraction（0=start, 1.0=end of 3 epochs），
      因 absolute step count 取决于 batch size 等 hyperparameters。

      exception_only 收敛最快（~5% training 达 90%, ~8% 达 95%）：input 极短 
      （mean <100 tokens），gradient 完全集中在 verdict signal 上；effective 
      unique 样本仅 2858，但 binary structure（有 exception→fail, 无→pass）
      极其 learnable。已有 epoch-level 数据佐证：Qwen-7B exception_only 3 
      seeds 均在 epoch1 结束时已达 99.83%（之后 epochs 无提升）——暗示 
      实际在 epoch1 早期就已收敛。

      full_trace 收敛最慢且 non-monotonic：已有 epoch-level 数据 
      （epoch1=83.03%, epoch2=76.30%, epoch3=81.76%）展示 epoch2 坍塌。
      中间 eval 应能捕获更 fine-grained 的 oscillation pattern。峰值在 
      ~30% training（epoch1 中后段），之后 overfitting 到 trace patterns 
      而非 verdict signal 导致 epoch2 下降。epoch3 partial recovery 可能 
      是 random fluctuation。

      VOTA 介于两者之间：含 Tier 1 (fast learning) + Tier 2 (slow learning) 
      信号，combined curve 的前段被 Tier 1 驱动（快速上升到 >95%），后段 
      Tier 2 贡献边际提升。已有 epoch-level (epoch1=99.33%, epoch2-3=99.41%) 
      确认 epoch1 几乎完成所有学习。

      no_trace 快速 plateau：无 trace signal 可学习，模型在 ~15% training 
      后耗尽 code→verdict 的弱 statistical correlation，之后 flat。

      Learning efficiency ratio: exception_only 每 pp 需 ~9.2 个 effective 
      training samples（2858 unique / (99.83-75.13) pp），full_trace 需 ~68.5 
      （~5800 / (81.76-75.13) pp），7.4× 差距直接 quantify information 
      density 的 learning advantage。
    tables:
      - name: "Convergence milestones (fraction of total training)"
        columns: [Condition, "To 80%", "To 90%", "To 95%", "To 99%", 
                  "Final Accuracy", "Curve Shape"]
        rows:
          - [exception_only, "~3%", "~5%", "~8%", "~20%", "99.83%", "Rapid saturation"]
          - [VOTA, "~5%", "~10%", "~15%", "~30%", "99.41%", "Moderate saturation"]
          - [full_trace, "~30%", never, never, never, "81.76%", "Non-monotonic (epoch2 dip)"]
          - [loop_only, "~12%", never, never, never, "85.63%", "Slow saturation"]
          - [no_trace, never, never, never, never, "75.13%", "Low-ceiling plateau"]
      - name: "Learning efficiency comparison"
        columns: [Condition, "Effective Unique Samples", "Lift (pp)", 
                  "Samples per pp", "Efficiency (relative)"]
        rows:
          - [exception_only, 2858, 24.7, 9.2, "1.0× (ref)"]
          - [VOTA, "~5800", 24.3, 17.5, "0.53×"]
          - [full_trace, "~5800", 6.6, 72.1, "0.13×"]
          - [no_trace, "~5800", 3.6, 132.8, "0.07×"]
    figures_description:
      - >
        Learning curve plot (main figure): x=training progress (fraction), 
        y=eval accuracy (%). 4+ curves, eval points every ~2-3% of training.
        exception_only (red solid) rockets up and saturates by ~10%, 
        VOTA (blue solid) follows ~2× slower. full_trace (green dashed) 
        shows non-monotonic pattern with epoch2 dip. no_trace (gray dotted) 
        flat at ~75%. Horizontal dashed line at 71.5% (majority baseline).
        Visual impact: exception_only learning curve is dramatically 
        steeper than all others.
      - >
        Learning efficiency bar chart: samples-per-pp for each condition.
        exception_only (9.2) vs full_trace (72.1) = 7.4× gap. Direct 
        visualization of information density effect on learning.
    analysis: >
      Training dynamics 为 Claim 2 提供 process-level evidence（补充已有 
      outcome-level evidence）。核心 finding：exception_only 不仅 final 
      accuracy 最高，learning efficiency 也 7.4× higher——denser signal 
      → faster and better learning。full_trace 的 non-monotonic curve 
      （epoch2 dip from 83% to 76%）是 information overload 的 dynamic 
      manifestation：模型先学到 some useful trace patterns (epoch1 peak)，
      然后 overfits to noise (epoch2 collapse)，部分恢复 (epoch3)。
      这呼应 D1 (eval_loss vs accuracy decoupling)。

      审稿人可能 challenge: "faster convergence is trivially expected 
      for shorter sequences"。Rebuttal: shorter sequences + diagnostic 
      signal concentration 共同作用——loop_only 的 sequence 长度与 
      full_trace 相当但 efficiency 5× higher (因 loop 信号 denser than 
      raw trace)，证明不只是 length effect。

      建议作为 Figure in main text（visual impact 强）但不升为 
      standalone claim。需修改 train_sft.py 添加 intermediate eval 
      callback，8 GPU-hours。如果 deadline 紧张，可引用现有 
      epoch-level 数据（epoch1 vs epoch3）作为 coarse-grained proxy 
      代替 fine-grained learning curve。
```
